A little street sense

Fight your way across Accra.

Screen controls: Full enters or exits fullscreen. Rotate switches between landscape and portrait where supported. If prompted, turn your phone and enable auto-rotate.

Street tricks: press R near the luggage trolley to bowl through rivals, or tip the cooler to create a slippery patch. Props reset when the next trotro arrives. Changing crowd dares reward +10 health and special charge. Rivals fight each other and you. Be the last fighter standing to board through either entrance. Defeated rivals stay down until the next trotro arrives. Each new vehicle brings a fresh crowd and removes the old passengers. After an attack connects, L / Space cancels recovery into a dodge. At critical health, one comeback per encounter fills your special meter.

City Journey has 18 encounters across six districts. Win the crowd fight, then claim the seat through the door or window. Every completed encounter saves your progress. Losses let you retry that encounter with your build intact. Between rides, Continue restores health and keeps your upgrades. Open the optional choices to add an upgrade, fill your special meter, or try a tougher fight for more score. Carry up to three upgrades; adding another requires choosing one to replace. Endless Commute keeps adding districts. Quick ride and the daily route keep the original three-stop format.

Watch the road while you choose a weapon. Trotros pull into the bay and passengers gather at the door. Defeat every rival, then hold E at the door. You can attempt the marked window with G, but nearby rivals can pull you down and you cannot claim the seat until the fight is won. The mate guards the window: shove him with F or wait for him to turn away, then vault. Hold Fight (J) during a climb to kick grabbers away. On mobile, the wide button offers Shove mate, Vault window, Kick free, Pull rival down or Hold to board. Rivals compete through both the door and window. When the orange boarding alert appears, hit or shove that rival to interrupt. If they take the seat, the trotro leaves full and you must wait for the next one. Full buses leave; the next one has space. Missing an available trotro costs 5 health when it leaves, including a seat taken by a rival. Buses that arrive already full cost no health. Your weapon and score carry over. In Quick ride, win three stops to get home and recover 25 health per ride. City Journey and Endless use the travel choices and saved checkpoints instead.

JLight strike. Confirm hits into combos: J J I launches, J U U spins, U J I drives through. Press M for all moves.
FPower shove. Push blockers out of the doorway. Recharges in 4 seconds.
QLast Seat Special. Fill the meter, get close, then unleash three cinematic strikes. The final hit launches nearby rivals.
K · holdBlock incoming hits. Use S + K against low sweeps. A perfect block opens a counter: press I to launch.
L / SpaceDodge in your movement direction.
RUse a nearby street trick, equip a weapon, or drink for +30 health. A new weapon replaces the one you carry.
E · holdEnter through the door after every rival is defeated.
GClimb at the window. You must win the fight to enter. Shove the watching mate; hold J to kick away grabbers.
Esc / PPause and take a breath.

Complete the timed stop challenge for +300 points and +15 health. Keep landing hits for a score multiplier up to ×3. Taking an unblocked hit or waiting too long breaks the streak. An orange ring means a rival is about to swing. A large red ring warns of a heavy sweep: dodge it. Dodge, then strike while they recover. Staggered rivals recover; defeated rivals disappear when a fresh crowd arrives. Win the fight before entering through either entrance.

 Fight for Trotro

Accra’s rush.
Turned up to eleven.

A busy trotro stop with a waiting queue, marked boarding bays and passing traffic. A fictional scramble for the last seat. A saved journey across the city, readable combat, everyday objects, and the unmistakable energy of trying to get home.

Feel the fight

Five weapons, three combo routes, launchers, air juggles, low sweeps, throws and a cinematic special. Break guards and punish missed swings.

Know your city

Six location-inspired arenas, built for the game. The layouts are creative interpretations.

Make the escape

Conquer 18 encounters in City Journey or keep going in Endless Commute. Clear the objective, make an opening, and hold Board to claim the seat.

Character and surface art

Human models and motion from Microsoft Rocketbox. Asphalt by Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven.

City Journey has six districts, each with a queue clash, seat defence and captain showdown. Build around three active upgrades and choose recovery, special charge or higher stakes between rides. Defeat retries the current encounter; completed encounters stay saved. Endless Commute keeps going, with a separate save. Quick rides and daily routes offer the original three-stop run. Mix four attacks or defensive actions within six seconds to trigger Rush: +25% damage and half-cost dodges for six seconds. Interrupting a boarding rival buys two seconds and earns 100 points. Daily routes use the same fighter, route and rules for every attempt that day. Career progress is saved on this device.

Google Maps links open the real locations for exploration. Street View imagery is not included in these arenas.

Who’s going home?

Different lives. The same last seat. Choose your commuter.

 Combat lab / original moves

Make every hit count.

Mobile: drag the joystick, hold Fight for combos, hold Guard, and tap Dodge to escape. The wide button changes to Throw, Street trick, Shove mate, Vault window or Hold to board as needed. Rivals fight each other and you. Win the fight before boarding through either entrance. Hold Fight while climbing to kick grabbers away; use Pull rival down to stop a window rival. Retreat for four seconds to begin recovering health, up to 70.

Tap a sequence as your hits connect. Two inputs can be buffered. A blocked hit or a miss breaks the route. Kicks and throws work with every weapon.

J / I / U / OLight / heavy / kick / close throw
S + U / W + ULow sweep / flying knee. The mobile Fight button chains attacks and uses sweeps against guards.
K / S + KHigh / low block. Time K just before impact for a perfect block, then I for a launching counter.
L / SpaceDodge a live swing, then counter with I.
QLast Seat Special. Needs a full meter and a nearby rival.
TabSwitch the focused rival. Attacks turn towards your target.
F / E / RShove / hold to board / pick up. Interrupt an orange boarding rival before their bar fills.

Throws and heavy finishers can send rivals crashing into each other. Mix four moves or defensive actions within six seconds for Rush: bonus damage and cheaper dodges. A cyan ring means high guard: use a low sweep or throw. Heavy attacks break guard. After Circle Uppercut, follow with J or U while your rival is airborne. Juggles lose damage and end after three air hits.
